name: Munki Repo
description: Munki is an open-source software deployment tool for macOS. This installs a self-hosted Munki package repository (pkgs/pkgsinfo/catalogs/manifests) served over HTTP, plus MunkiWebAdmin2 for editing manifests and pkginfo and rebuilding catalogs from a browser. Munki's own Managed Software Center gives macOS users a self-service app catalog, so it pairs well with a free-tier MDM like Fleet (whose Software/app-catalog features are Premium-only) for enrollment, inventory, and policy while Munki handles software distribution.

notes.text: The repo (http://<IP>/repo) and MunkiWebAdmin2 (http://<IP>:8081) are served over plain HTTP with no client authentication by default. Put a TLS reverse proxy in front for production use, especially over untrusted networks.

There is no macOS admin tool bundled here. Add packages with munkiimport or MunkiAdmin from a Mac (point it at /srv/munki_repo over rsync/scp/sshfs), or add script-only/nopkg pkginfo directly in MunkiWebAdmin2, then use its "Rebuild catalogs" action.

"Rebuild catalogs" runs a Linux-compatible build of munki's official makecatalogs logic (vendored from github.com/munki/munki, Apache-2.0) since the real makecatalogs is a macOS-only binary as of Munki 6+.
The repo is a git working tree (git log in /srv/munki_repo) and MunkiWebAdmin2 is configured to auto-commit manifest/pkginfo edits, so changes are recoverable.
